## Summary
Show feedback diagnostic log links when returned by the inspect endpoint.

## Changes
- Add the optional diagnostic_log field to the FeedbackRecord API client type.
- Render diagnostic_log as a clickable external link in the feedback summary panel when present.
- Add localized labels for the diagnostic error log field.
